exposure: BTCP (both husband and wife only children)
cohort: 270,878 singleton births in Hebei Province, China, from January 1, 2013, to December 31, 2017
finding: The sex ratio at birth (SRB) in China declined to a normal level with the gradual liberalization of the Two-Child Policy, influenced by factors like advanced maternal age, cesarean delivery, multiparity, middle-level education, and rural hospital delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher SRB.
